playoff.entries: 9th of the PrvaLiga vs 2nd of the 2. SNL
playoff.note: The 10th-placed club is relegated directly; 9th defends its place over two legs. Same tie as the 2. SNL promotion play-off.
The champion is promoted directly (subject to licensing); 2nd plays the PrvaLiga 9th over two legs.

format.note: Under-19 championship (Slovenian Junior League) of the clubs' youth sides; round count not published on the sources used.

boundaries.note: 2. SNL champion up directly, runner-up in a two-legged tie against the PrvaLiga 9th. PrvaLiga 10th down directly, 9th only through that tie. One shared place.

notes: SL1: 10 clubs, four meetings each (36 rounds) - not a double round robin. 10th relegated, 9th in a two-legged play-off against the 2. SNL runner-up. SL2: 16 clubs, 30 rounds; champion up (licensing applies), 2nd to the play-off, bottom two down to the regional 3. SNL (level 3, not modelled, hence closed_down=true). SL19 is the U19 EON NextGen Liga with 16 youth sides: closed both ways, no senior route. 2026-27 PrvaLiga ran 17 Jul 2026 - 22 May 2027; Nafta 1903 won the 2026 play-off 1-0 on aggregate against Primorje.
